info.title: GlazeAudio API
info.description: REST API for GlazeAudio – a platform for reviewing music. Resources are hierarchical: albums → songs → reviews. Reviews are written by users.

get.summary: API entry point with links to the main resources

get.description: Returns one page of albums with their song count, review count and average rating. Filter with search, artist, genre, fromYear and toYear. Paging metadata and first/prev/next/last links are included in the response.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, 1–50. Default 10.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text to find in the album title or artist (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Only albums whose artist contains this text.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Only albums whose genre contains this text, e.g. 'rock'.

parameters.name: fromYear
parameters.description: Only albums released in or after this year.

parameters.name: toYear
parameters.description: Only albums released in or before this year.

post.description: Creates a new album. Returns 201 with a Location header that points to the new album.

put.description: Replaces all editable fields of the album.

delete.description: Deletes the album together with all of its songs and their reviews. Returns 204 with no body.

get.description: A dashboard-style resource built from three entities: the album, its songs with their ratings, rating statistics per aspect across all reviews, the top-rated song and the latest reviews.

get.summary: List songs of an album (paged, filterable)
get.description: Returns one page of the album's songs ordered by track number. Filter with search, minDuration and maxDuration. 404 if the album does not exist.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, 1–50. Default 10.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text to find in the song title (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: minDuration
parameters.description: Only songs at least this long (seconds).

parameters.name: maxDuration
parameters.description: Only songs at most this long (seconds).

post.summary: Add a song to an album

get.description: 404 if the album does not exist or the song does not belong to it.

delete.description: Deletes the song and all of its reviews. Returns 204 with no body.

get.summary: List reviews of a song (paged, filterable)
get.description: Returns one page of the song's reviews, newest first. Filter with author (username), userId, minRating and maxRating (overall rating = average of the 4 aspects). 404 if the album or song does not exist, or the song is not on that album.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, 1–50. Default 10.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Only reviews by this author's username (exact match, case-insensitive).

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Only reviews written by this user id.

parameters.name: minRating
parameters.description: Only reviews whose overall rating (average of the 4 aspects) is at least this value, 0–5.

parameters.name: maxRating
parameters.description: Only reviews whose overall rating is at most this value, 0–5.

post.description: Each aspect (lyrics, melody, mood, expressiveness) is rated 0–5. The author is given as userId (until authentication is added). 422 if a rating is out of range or the user does not exist; 409 if this user has already reviewed the song.

put.description: Replaces the ratings and comment. The author cannot be changed.

delete.description: Used by administrators to remove harmful reviews. Returns 204 with no body.

get.description: Filter with search (username or email) and role (User / Admin).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, 1–50. Default 10.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text to find in the username or email (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Only users with this role: User or Admin.

post.description: Creates an account with the User role. The password is stored as a salted hash and never returned. 409 if the username or email is already taken.

put.description: Replaces username, email, bio and role. 409 if the new username or email is already taken.

delete.description: Deletes the account together with all reviews it wrote. Returns 204 with no body.

get.description: Every review the user has written, newest first, with the song and album each one belongs to. Filter with minRating.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, 1–50. Default 10.

parameters.name: minRating
parameters.description: Only reviews whose overall rating is at least this value, 0–5.
